https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Too.title: AUTOR
https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Too.description: AUTORxx (auto-reply policy specifications) defines auto-reply notification handling and message-specific auto-reply policies. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=specifications-statements-parameters-autorxx

notification_message_destination.description: (NOTIFYMSGS) Controls where auto-reply notification messages are written. If omitted, HC is the default. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=specifications-statements-parameters-autorxx

message_reply_definitions.description: Message-specific auto-reply policy definitions. Each definition starts with MSGID() and can specify NOAUTOREPLY or a reply policy with DELAY(), REPLY(), and optional RATELIMIT(). https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=specifications-syntax-format-autorxx

message_id.description: (MSGID) Message identifier to match. The message ID must be 1-10 characters. It can include question mark wildcards, but if it contains both question mark and asterisk the definition is rejected. Preserve case by quoting when needed. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=specifications-statements-parameters-autorxx

suppress_auto_reply.description: (NOAUTOREPLY) Suppresses auto-reply processing for the specified message ID and causes later definitions of the same message ID to be ignored.

reply_delay.description: (DELAY) Minimum delay before the system issues the reply. Specify the value as a three-digit or smaller number followed by M for minutes or S for seconds, for example 5S or 10M. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=specifications-statements-parameters-autorxx

reply_text_segments.description: (REPLY) Reply text segments to concatenate into the issued reply. Each segment is limited to 64 characters. Quote a segment when it contains blanks or non-alphanumeric characters, or when case must be preserved. A null reply can be specified with a blank string segment. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=specifications-statements-parameters-autorxx

reply_rate_limit_per_second.description: (RATELIMIT) Number of replies per second allowed for this message ID. Valid values are 001-999. RATELIMIT is only valid when DELAY is set to 0. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=specifications-statements-parameters-autorxx

https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Too.title: IZUPRMxx Configuration Schema
https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Too.description: Schema for z/OS Management Facility (z/OSMF) configuration parameters. See: https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=system-izuprmxx-reference-information

hostname.description: (HOSTNAME) Specifies the hostname, as defined by DNS, where the z/OSMF server is located. Use '*' to listen on all adapters, or specify a specific IP address or hostname.

http_ssl_port.description: (HTTP_SSL_PORT) Identifies the port number that is associated with the z/OSMF server for SSL encrypted traffic.

incident_log_unit.description: (INCIDENT_LOG UNIT) Specifies the device to be used for storing data sets and z/OS UNIX files for the FTP jobs that are used for the Incident Log service. Must be a generic name (e.g., '3390') or esoteric name (e.g., 'DISK', 'SYSALLDA').

unit.description: (UNIT) Specifies the device to be used for storing data sets and z/OS UNIX files for the FTP jobs that are used for the Incident Log service. Must be a generic name (e.g., '3390') or esoteric name (e.g., 'DISK', 'SYSALLDA').

java_home.description: (JAVA_HOME) Specifies the fully qualified path name for IBM Semeru Runtime Certified Edition on your system. Must be a valid z/OS UNIX System Services path name beginning with '/'.

keyring_name.description: (KEYRING_NAME) Specifies the key ring name for the z/OSMF server. Must be the name of a valid RACF profile in the DIGTRING class. Format: IZUKeyring.<SAF_PREFIX>

logging_specification.description: (LOGGING) Initial trace state for the z/OSMF server. These settings are read when the server is started. Case sensitive.

logging_specification_object.description: (LOGGING) Initial trace state for the z/OSMF server. These settings are read when the server is started. Case sensitive.

info.description: Specifies Datasets to be logged as warning

fine.description: Specifies Datasets to be logged as warning

finer.description: Specifies Datasets to be logged as warning

finest.description: Specifies Datasets to be logged as warning

warning.description: Specifies Datasets to be logged as warning

rest_api_file_tso.description: (RESTAPI_FILE) Specifies values for the TSO logon procedure that is used internally by the z/OS data set and file REST interface services.

account_number.description: (ACCT) Account number to be used for the TSO/E logon procedure for the z/OS data set and file REST interface services.

region_size.description: (REGION) Region size (in kilobytes) to be used for the TSO/E logon procedure for the z/OS data set and file REST interface services.

procedure_name.description: (PROC) TSO/E logon procedure to be used for operations with the z/OS data set and file REST interface services. Must be a valid partitioned data set member name.

common_tso.description: (COMMON_TSO) Specifies values for the TSO/E logon procedure that is used internally for various z/OSMF activities (console REST interface, Software Management, Workflows).

account_number.description: (ACCT) Account number to be used for the common TSO/E logon procedure for z/OSMF.

region_size.description: (REGION) Region size (in kilobytes) to be used for the common logon procedure for z/OSMF.

procedure_name.description: (PROC) TSO/E logon procedure to be used for z/OSMF. Must be a valid partitioned data set member name.

saf_prefix.description: (SAF_PREFIX) SAF profile prefix that is prepended to the names of any resource profile names to be used for the z/OSMF core functions and optional services. Must follow the rules for RACF profile names.

cloud_saf_prefix.description: (CLOUD_SAF_PREFIX) SAF profile prefix that is prepended to the names of any groups to be used for authorizing users to IBM Cloud Provisioning and Management for z/OS task activities. Must follow the rules for RACF profile names.

cloud_security_admin.description: (CLOUD_SEC_ADMIN) Specifies the security administrator user ID to be used for automatic security management in Cloud Provisioning. When specified, automatic security updates are performed under this user ID. If omitted, security updates for Cloud Provisioning must be performed manually. Must follow the rules for z/OS user IDs.

security_groups.description: (SEC_GROUPS) Specifies group names for the base set of z/OSMF security groups: user, administrator, and z/OS security administrator.

user_group.description: (USER) Security group to be used for the z/OSMF user role. The user IDs that are connected to this group are considered to be z/OSMF users.

admin_group.description: (ADMIN) Security group to be used for the z/OSMF administrator role. The user IDs that are connected to this group are considered to be z/OSMF administrators.

security_admin_group.description: (SECADMIN) Group name to be used for the z/OS Security Administrator role. This group is permitted to the Workflows task.

session_timeout.description: (SESSION_EXPIRE) Amount of time (in minutes) for the session timeout. z/OSMF user sessions expire when this period elapses.

temporary_directory.description: (TEMP_DIR) Temporary directory for various z/OSMF activities (Incident Log, Workflows, Diagnostic Assistant). Users of these tasks require write access to this directory. Must be a valid z/OS UNIX path name.

csrf_protection_enabled.description: (CSRF_SWITCH) Indicates whether Cross Site Request Forgery (CSRF) custom header checking is enabled for REST API requests. True enables CSRF checking (ON), false disables it (OFF). It is recommended to leave this enabled to prevent CSRF attacks.

server_procedure.description: (SERVER_PROC) Specifies the name of the started procedure that is used to start the z/OSMF server on this system. Must specify a valid partitioned data set member name.

angel_procedure.description: (ANGEL_PROC) Specifies the started procedure that is used to start the z/OSMF angel process on this system. Must specify a valid partitioned data set member name.

autostart_mode.description: (AUTOSTART) Specifies whether the z/OSMF server is to be started automatically on this system. 'local' indicates automatic start, 'connect' indicates no autostart on local system.

autostart_group.description: (AUTOSTART_GROUP) Associates the local system with other systems that can share an autostarted z/OSMF server. Defines a domain for z/OSMF work and associated persistent data within a sysplex. Must consist of 1-32 alphanumeric characters (A-Z, a-z, 0-9) or special characters (#, $, @).

primary.description: (DEPRECATED - use autostart) Controlled z/OSMF server startup mode in z/OS V2R2 and earlier. Values: 'local' (start server), 'customer' (custom control). Replaced by AUTOSTART in z/OS V2R3 (2017).

primary_group.description: (DEPRECATED - use autostart_group) Specified primary group designation in z/OS V2R2 and earlier. Replaced by AUTOSTART_GROUP in z/OS V2R3 (2017).

user_directory.description: (USER_DIR) z/OSMF data directory path. Every autostart group within a sysplex must have a unique specification. If you plan to use an autostarted z/OSMF server, this file system must be mounted when you IPL the system. Must be a valid z/OS UNIX path name.

unauthenticated_user.description: (UNAUTH_USER) Represents an unauthenticated user. Provides an unknown user with basic privileges to access the z/OSMF log-in page, but nothing more. Must follow the rules for z/OS user IDs.

workload_manager_classes_classes.description: (WLM_CLASSES) Specifies the WLM transaction classes for managing z/OSMF work.

default_class.description: (DEFAULT) WLM transaction class to be used for managing z/OSMF work, except for long-running work. Must specify a valid WLM transaction class name.

long_running_work_class.description: (LONG_WORK) WLM transaction class to be used for managing the execution of long-running work. Must specify a valid WLM transaction class name.

plugins.description: (PLUGINS) Specifies the optional services to be made available in your configuration. Each item must be a valid service identifier.

https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Too.title: HZSPRM
https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Too.description: (HZSPRMxx) IBM Health Checker for z/OS configuration. Controls check execution, policies, and system parameters. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=command-syntax-parameters-hzsprmxx-modify-hzsproc

outdated.description: (OUTDATED) Display information about checks that are outdated.

status.description: (STATUS) Displays status information about IBM Health Checker for z/OS and checks in message HZS0203I

policy_names.description: (POLICIES) Displays the names of all policies that are defined for IBM Health Checker for z/OS.

display_area.description: (L) Optionally specifies the display area, n, where the display is to appear. If you omit this operand, the display is presented in the first available display area or the message area of the console through which you enter the command.

locale.description: (LOCALE) Specifies whether you want to display local or remote checks:

detailed_output.description: (DETAIL | SUMMARY) IBM Health Checker for z/OS issues message HZS200I with detailed or summary information about the specified checks.

availability.description: (ANY | NOTDELETED | DELETED) Displays information about checks based on the specification.

policy_exceptions.description: (POLICYEXCEPTIONS) Display information about checks for which a policy statement matching the check was not applied because the date on the policy statement is older than the check date.

exceptions.description: (EXCEPTIONS) Display information about checks that completed with a nonzero return value.

diag.description: (DIAG) Displays more diagnostic data such as the check routine address and message table address.

activate.description: (ACTIVATE) Sets the specified check or checks to the active state.

deactivate.description: (ACTIVATE) Sets the specified check or checks to the active state.

health_checker_data_set.description: (HZSPDATA) Specify data set for saving check data between restarts

volume.description: Volume serial where data set resides

add_definition.description: (ADD) Add check definition. Rejects if check already exists.

add_replace_definition.description: (ADDREPLACE) Add check definition. Rejects if check already exists.

oneOf.description: SYSTEM = same as INTERVAL, HALF = half of INTERVAL

minute.description: Minute component (runs every hour at this minute)

oneOf.description: Date with NOCHECK option to bypass verification

rexx_hlq.description: (REXXHLQ) High-level qualifier for REXX data sets

rexx_time_limit.description: (REXXTIMELIMIT) Execution time limit in seconds (0 = no limit)

rexx_in.description: (REXXIN) Requires input data set (only if REXXTSO=NO)

message_table.description:
(MESSAGETABLE) specifies the module name of the message table that will be used when generating messages for the check you are adding or replacing.
This can either be false or a string. Boolean `false` - (represents *NONE) indicates that you are adding or replacing a check that has no associated message table, by using instead HZSFMSG REQUEST=DIRECTMSG or HZSLFMSG_REQUEST='DIRECTMSG' to issue messages directly from the check routine. A string specifies a name for the message table.

global.description: (GLOBAL) Specifies that the check that you are adding or replacing is global, which means that it runs on one system but reports on sysplex-wide values and practices. If you do not specify GLOBAL, the systems assume that the check is local, which means that it runs on each system in the sysplex where it is active and enabled.

requires_unix.description: (USS) specifies whether the check uses z/OS UNIX System Services.

entry_code.description: (ENTRYCODE) specifies an optional unique check entry value that is needed when a check routine contains multiple checks. This value is passed to the check routine in the field Pqe_EntryCode in mapping macro HZSPQE.

allow_dynamic_severity.description:
(ALLOWDYNSEV) specifies whether this check can issue check exception messages with a dynamically varying severity level.
 Default: false (NO) - specifies that the check is not allowed to specify a dynamic severity.
 true (YES) - specifies that the check can specify the severity dynamically. A check with ALLOWDYNSEV=YES can use the SEVERITY parameter on the HZSFMSG service (or HZSLFMSG_SEVERITY for REXX service HZSLFMSG) to send check that is defined exception messages with a dynamic severity. Further information at: https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=command-syntax-parameters-hzsprmxx-modify-hzsproc#synparm__filters

dom.description:
(DOM) specifies whether the check or the system delete the write to operator (WTO) messages from previous check iterations that use delete operator message (DOM) requests.
 Default: true (SYSTEM) - indicates that the system issues DOM requests to delete any WTOs from previous check iterations just before the start of a new check iteration.
 false (CHECK) - indicates that the check is expected to issue its own DOM requests to delete previous check exception WTOs using HZSFMSG REQUEST=DOM or HZSLFMSG_REQUEST=DOM, with few exceptions, as found here: https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=command-syntax-parameters-hzsprmxx-modify-hzsproc#synparm__filters

categories.description: Filter by category membership. Checks must belong to at least one specified category.

owner.description: Check owner (uppercase folded, no reserved words)

https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Too.title: AXR
https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Too.description: AXRxx (system REXX options) specifies options for system REXX. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=sys1parmlib-axrxx-system-rexx-options

axr_user_id.description: (AXRUSER) Specifies a 1-8 character user ID that defines the security environment for execs initiated using the AXREXX macro when SECURITY=BYAXRUSER is specified. The exec runs with the authorization level associated with this user ID. The installation must provide SAF access to SYSREXX.<userid>. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=options-statements-parameters-axrxx

prefix.description: (CPF) Defines a 1-8 character command prefix value for System REXX that can be used instead of the MODIFY AXR command. The prefix can be SYSTEM (recognized only on the system where defined) or SYSPLEX (recognized throughout the sysplex). Default: CPF('REXX&SYSCLONE.',SYSPLEX). https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=options-statements-parameters-axrxx

prefix_value.description: The command prefix value (1-8 characters, may include system symbols which expand at runtime)

scope.description: Scope of the command prefix (SYSTEM or SYSPLEX)

maximum_tso_servers.description: (MAXTSOSERVERS) The maximum number of TSO server address spaces. Valid range: 1-16. Default: 8. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=options-statements-parameters-axrxx

maximum_worker_tasks.description: (MAXWORKERTASKS) Maximum number of worker tasks running TSO=NO work in the AXR address space. Valid range: 4-32. If a value greater than 32 is specified, the default of 32 is used. Default: 32. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=options-statements-parameters-axrxx

rexx_libraries.description: (REXXLIB ADD) The REXXLIB concatenation is an ordered list of data sets where System REXX searches for execs. All data sets must have the same record type and length as SYS1.SAXREXEC and must be PDS or PDSE. The total number of extents must not exceed 255. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=options-statements-parameters-axrxx

mvs_directory.description: (DSN) The name of the REXX library data set

disk.description: Disk (optional if data set is cataloged)

time_interval_limit.description: (TIMEINT) Default time limit on REXX execs in seconds. Valid range: 0-21474536. When 0 is specified, there is no time limit. Default: 30 seconds. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=options-statements-parameters-axrxx

https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Too.title: FXEPRM
https://ibm.com/schemas/zosconfig/v0/Too.description: FXEPRMxx (Function Registry for z/OS) controls function enablement in the IBM Function Registry. Each statement identifies a function by vendor, product, and function name or slot number, and sets its enablement state. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=sys1parmlib-fxeprmxx-function-registry-zos

function_enablement_statements.description: Function enablement statements. Each statement identifies a function in the IBM Function Registry and sets its enablement state. Functions can be identified by name (with wildcard support) or by slot number at each registry level (vendor, product, function). https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=zos-syntax-format-fxeprmxx

vendor_name.description: (VENDORNAME, VENDOR, VN) Identifies the owning vendor area by name. Supports wildcards: * (zero or more characters) and ? (single character). Case-insensitive matching. Mutually exclusive with vendor_slot. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=zos-statements-parameters-fxeprmxx

vendor_slot.description: (VENDORSLOT, VS) Identifies the owning vendor area by slot number in the anchor table. Slot numbers start at 1. Mutually exclusive with vendor_name. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=zos-statements-parameters-fxeprmxx

product_name.description: (PRODUCTNAME, PRODUCT, PN) Identifies the owning product area by name. Supports wildcards: * (zero or more characters) and ? (single character). Case-insensitive matching. Mutually exclusive with product_slot. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=zos-statements-parameters-fxeprmxx

product_slot.description: (PRODUCTSLOT, PS) Identifies the owning product area by slot number in the vendor area table. Slot numbers start at 1. Mutually exclusive with product_name. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=zos-statements-parameters-fxeprmxx

product_id.description: (PRODUCTID, PID) Qualifies the product area using a product ID. Supports wildcards: * (zero or more characters) and ? (single character). Case-insensitive matching. Optional in syntax but required to match products registered with a product ID. Distinguishes different instances or versions of the same product. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=zos-statements-parameters-fxeprmxx

instance_id.description: (INSTANCEID, IID) Qualifies the product area using an instance ID. Supports wildcards: * (zero or more characters) and ? (single character). Case-insensitive matching. Optional in syntax but required to match products registered with an instance ID. Distinguishes different instances or versions of the same product. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=zos-statements-parameters-fxeprmxx

function_name.description: (FUNCTIONNAME, FUNCTION, FN) Identifies the function entry by name. Supports wildcards: * (zero or more characters) and ? (single character). Case-insensitive matching. Mutually exclusive with function_slot. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=zos-statements-parameters-fxeprmxx

function_slot.description: (FUNCTIONSLOT, FS) Identifies the function entry by slot number in the product area. Slot numbers start at 1. Mutually exclusive with function_name. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=zos-statements-parameters-fxeprmxx

function_update_type.description: (FUNCTIONUPDTYPE, FUNCUPDTYPE, FUT) Selects function entries based on authorization requirements. AUTHONLY (default) selects functions updatable only by authorized code and SETFXE command. ANYAUTH selects functions updatable by any authorization level (unauthorized code must use FXECNTRL service) or SETFXE command. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=zos-statements-parameters-fxeprmxx

enabled.description: (ENABLED) Sets the desired enablement state for the selected function entry. True enables the function, false disables it. https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/latest?topic=zos-statements-parameters-fxeprmxx
